title: Integral triangularization from a primitive eigenvector
statement: Let γ∈SL₂(ℤ) and ε,p,q∈ℤ. Assume ε²=1, IsCoprime p q, and γ(p,q)ᵀ=(εp,εq)ᵀ. Then there exist σ∈SL₂(ℤ) and b∈ℤ such that the underlying matrix of σ⁻¹γσ is (ε b;0 ε).
